title: The Brothers Karamazov
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
firstLine: Alexey Fyodorovitch Karamazov was the third son of Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov, a land owner well known in our district in his own day, and still remembered among us owing to his gloomy and tragic death, which happened thirteen years ago, and which I shall describe in its proper place.
begins: Book I, 'The History of a Family', is told by a local narrator. It describes the lecherous buffoon Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov, his two marriages, and how he neglected his sons Dmitri, Ivan and Alexey.
happens: Old Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov and his eldest son Dmitri (Mitya) both pursue Grushenka, and quarrel over money and inheritance. Ivan, the intellectual, and the devout Alyosha, a novice under Father Zossima, are the other sons. Fyodor Pavlovitch is found murdered. Mitya, who had threatened him, is arrested and tried. The servant Smerdyakov, who did the deed, confesses to Ivan and hangs himself; Ivan falls into brain fever. Despite this, Mitya is found guilty and faces Siberia, with an escape planned. Alyosha, who has befriended a group of schoolboys, ends the book speaking to them at Ilusha's stone after the boy's funeral.
